MCD.rationale: MCD is a structurally high-quality franchise (90% gross margins, 45%+ operating margins, $2.4B OCF in seasonal trough, 96% franchised) with solid YoY fundamental momentum (revenue +9.4%, EPS +6.9%). The stock has derated ~4 P/E turns (rough proxy ~25x annualized vs ~29x a year ago) while fundamentals improved, and sits -17.9% below 52-week highs near the low end of its range. Oil's -39% decline is a genuine margin tailwind. However, the case is tempered by: (1) incomplete valuation data (corrupted P/E, no EV/EBIT or FCF yield) preventing a confident 'cheap' call; (2) a challenging U.S. consumer backdrop with lower-income pullback and franchisee margin pressure from value promotions; (3) higher effective tax rate (22% vs 19.8%) and 4-6% higher interest expense as structural headwinds; (4) negative equity balance sheet offering no margin of safety; and (5) 10Y yield at 4.49% compressing multiples for steady-state compounders. The score reflects a good franchise at a more reasonable but not clearly cheap valuation, with near-term consumer headwinds partially offset by the oil tailwind and defensive rotation. No strong dated catalyst tilts the score meaningfully higher.
